statements.attributed: dual-phase HEAs featuring face-centered cubic (fcc) and body-centered cubic (bcc) phases exhibit a superior balance of strength and ductility
statements.quote: A prominent illustration is the dual-phase HEAs featuring face-centered cubic (fcc) and body-centered cubic (bcc) phases, which exhibit a superior balance of strength and ductility. While singe-phase bcc HEAs display limited ductility, fcc HEAs with single-phase showcase elevated ductility and diminished strength.

Another example is FeRhIrPdPt, which shows a mixture of two fcc phases with different chemical compositions. The major fcc phase is rich in Rh and Ir, while the minor one is enriched in Pd and Pt.

statements.attributed: enhanced mechanical properties resulting from thermal annealing in TiFeCoNi alloy
statements.quote: An initial investigation into FeCoNiTi has unveiled enhanced mechanical properties resulting from thermal annealing. The as-cast sample exhibits a two-phased dendritic microstructure featuring dendrites of hexagonal structure and an fcc interdendritic matrix. Following annealing at 1000 °C for 24 h, the sample demonstrates exceptional mechanical characteristics, including a yield strength of 1.33 GPa and an ultimate compressive strength of 2.6 GPa.

statements.attributed: as-cast FeCoNiTi manifests a dual-phase microstructure comprising fcc and hexagonal C14 Laves phases
statements.quote: A recent study by Liu et al. provides comprehensive structural and compositional analyses of FeCoNiTi. According to their findings, the as-cast FeCoNiTi manifests a dual-phase microstructure comprising fcc and hexagonal C14 Laves phases, with average elemental compositions of Fe17Co27Ni32Ti23 for the fcc phase and Fe32Co29Ni11Ti28 for the C14 phase, respectively.

statements.attributed: Bragg reflection positions of FeCoNiTi can be indexed by the fcc or hexagonal C14 Laves structure
statements.quote: In accordance with the findings elucidated by Liu et al., the Bragg reflection positions of FeCoNiTi can be indexed by the fcc or hexagonal C14 Laves structure.

statements.attributed: fcc phase corresponds to Fe17Co27Ni32Ti23, while the C14 phase corresponds to Fe32Co29Ni11Ti28
